doc.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015

title: Never turning down a date
summary: Bucky says you never knew what you would have to play, took every job, and would not say no next time.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: And now, when I was listening to you talk with Julia and Dick Hyman, Julia was talking about the studio days and she said to Dick, “you never turned anything down.”
And Ruth, you said to Bucky, “and neither did you.”
But John said, in an interview I saw, let’s see if I can find this, “my father worked his ass off but he never did anything he didn’t like.
Yeah. Well when they hire you you don’t know what you have to play. You know what I mean? © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
So after the day you may say what the hell did I do, I shouldn’t have taken this. But you still got paid.
Okay. Was there anything that you would say no to the next time around?
